name: What are the signs that my skylight needs to be replaced?
description: Signs include leaks, drafts, condensation, cracks, or yellowing/fogging of the dome, especially in older units.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my skylight needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common indicators that your skylight may need replacement include visible leaks, drafts, condensation between the glass panes, or cracks in the glass or frame. You might also notice a yellowing or fogging of the acrylic or polycarbonate dome, which reduces light transmission. Older skylights, especially those over 20 years old, are often less energy-efficient and may benefit from replacement with modern, insulated units to improve your home's thermal performance.
